title: An erase held with no drawing is not drawn again when the app comes to the front or at midnight; My data says the record did not load, and the record takes no edit, until the cloud sends another record
evidence: From the PR 1599 reviews (adversary F1 and F2, Codex R2). ios/HealthRoadmap/MyData/RecordStore.swift redraw guards on drawn != nil, so the held state (recordJSON the erased record, drawn nil, problem nil) is skipped; applyInTurn refuses every edit in that state. No pre-erase data: a redraw reads the erased record. While held, Apple Health's erase step records epoch 0 (AppleHealthSync+Owed.swift erased reads myData), so the first later draw disconnects Health again and deletes its copies made since. A fix lets redraw run when drawn is nil, problem is nil and recordJSON is not empty, with a test. US-25 AC16f
